theme_and_archetype.description: Authority, clarity, and elegance. Pure stark whites paired with deep charcoal blacks. Color is used strictly for function, focusing on typography, layout tension, and attractive motion to drive the premium SaaS feel.

anti_patterns: No Inter or generic sans for headings
No default bold weights; use fluid variable weights or distinct light/black pairings

layout_and_spacing.scale: Generous spacing: p-6 to p-12 for containers, py-24 to py-32 for marketing sections.
layout_and_spacing.marketing_grid: Mode A: The 'Tetris' Grid. 12-col base, wide gap-8 to gap-12, asymmetrical bento layouts. Heavy use of negative space.
layout_and_spacing.dashboard_grid: Mode B: The 'Control Room' Grid. 4-col base, tight gap-4 to gap-6. Flat backgrounds, 1px subtle borders, max rounded-lg.
layout_and_spacing.alignment: Left-align dense content and forms. Optical alignment for icons inside buttons.
layout_and_spacing.grid_technical: Grid items MUST be direct children. If using framer-motion, the motion.div must be the direct child.

patterns.hover: Slight lift (-translate-y-1) and shadow increase (shadow-md) on cards. Text color shifts.
patterns.entrance: Staggered fade-up for lists (candidates, job postings).
patterns.marquee: Editorial Ribbon style for platform integrations (Naukri, LinkedIn). Slow smooth drift, gap-24, text-sm text-zinc-500 uppercase tracking-widest.
patterns.transitions: transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out for basic state changes.
patterns.accessibility: Respect prefers-reduced-motion media query for all animations.

components.strategy: Shadcn UI deeply customized for interactive elements, raw HTML/Tailwind for creative marketing layouts.

specifics.buttons: Square or rounded-md (max 6px). High contrast bg-zinc-950 text-white hover:bg-zinc-800. For primary interactive actions: bg-blue-600 text-white hover:bg-blue-700.
specifics.cards: Cardless or flat geometric (border border-zinc-200 bg-white rounded-lg shadow-sm). NO heavy drop shadows.
specifics.tables: Shadcn Table for Candidate Shortlist. Dense, crisp borders (border-b border-zinc-100), clear typography.
specifics.inputs: Shadcn Form/Input. 1px border border-zinc-200 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-zinc-950 focus:border-zinc-950.
specifics.badges: For candidate scores/skills: rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-semibold bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-800.

hero_background.description: Minimalist white architectural interior. Use as a soft, low-opacity background layer (opacity-20) behind the main hero section to add depth without clutter.

ai_network_nodes.description: Abstract black and white structure. Use in a bento-grid card on the marketing page to represent the 'AI Sourcing Engine'.

team_collaboration.description: Three people collaborating with laptops. Use in the 'Email HR' or 'Team Handoff' feature section on the landing page.

icons.usage: Stroke width 1.5, size 20px for standard inline, 32px for feature highlights.

logos.instruction: NEVER use placeholder URLs for logos. For the main brand 'RecruitIT', use typography + Lucide Icon (e.g., <Cpu /> or <Briefcase />). For sponsor/partner logos (e.g., Naukri), build them using text + icons in grayscale.

pages_and_features.landing_page: High visual impact. Sticky crystal glass header. Massive bold H1 (Outfit). AI network image in bento grid. Smooth scrolling via lenis. Pricing table with 'Tracing Beam' active border.
pages_and_features.dashboard_layout: Sidebar navigation. Topbar with user profile and quick action 'New Job Post'. Main area with 'Control Room' dense grid for active jobs and pipeline stats.
pages_and_features.jd_creation: Clean split-pane or step-by-step form using Shadcn. Left: input fields (Title, Skills, Naukri sync toggle). Right: Live AI agent preview or JD output.
pages_and_features.candidate_pipeline: Kanban or dense Table view. Profile cards show Match Score (Progress bar with high contrast colors), 'Call Candidate' AI action button. Status badges.
pages_and_features.ai_screening_call: Interactive modal or dedicated view showing live call status/transcript simulated via Framer Motion.
pages_and_features.auth: Split screen: left side pure white form with high-contrast typography, right side abstract image with deep overlay and brand quote.
pages_and_features.settings: Standard Shadcn Tabs layout. Clear separation of profile, billing (subscription), and notification settings.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure all text meets minimum 4.5:1 ratio against backgrounds.
accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='create-jd-button', data-testid='candidate-card').

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the JSON structure for colors and fonts. Do not introduce generic blues or purples not defined here.
Implement Framer Motion for all card hovers and list entrances.
Build the dashboard using pure grid layouts, strictly avoiding Bootstrap-style nested containers where possible.
Use 'Outfit' for all Headings (H1-H4) and 'Manrope' for Body text. Import these from Google Fonts in index.html or global CSS.
Ensure all Shadcn UI components are customized to have sharp corners or max rounded-md (6px), discarding default heavy shadows.
Apply data-testid rigorously to all buttons, inputs, and major navigation links.
Remember to write React code in .js or .jsx files as requested by the environment.
Never use image placeholders like via.placeholder.com. Rely entirely on the provided media URLs and typographic logo constructions.
